newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to set schedule for benzene cut in gasoline.
newsitem.headline: Japan to set schedule for benzene cut in gasoline.

text.p: Japan is likely to set in October a time frame for lowering the maximum content of benzene in gasoline to one percent from the current five percent, a trade official said on Friday.

An official with the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said: "We are working to try to reach some kind of decision in October." He declined to comment on when the new benzene specification for gasoline was likely to be going into effect. Gasoline currently must contain less than seven percent of methyl tertiary butyl ether and a maximum five percent of benzene, according to specifications introduced in April.
